articles.title: Son-in-Law Falls at Mother-in-Law’s Feet on Aligarh Road, Family Dispute Behind Drama
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a young man holding the feet of his mother-in-law on a busy road in Aligarh district of Uttar Pradesh has gone viral on social media, drawing widespread attention. The man is seen lying at her feet and pleading, while the woman ignores him and refuses to engage.

body.html:
A video showing a young man holding the feet of his mother-in-law on a busy road in Aligarh district of Uttar Pradesh has gone viral on social media, drawing widespread attention. The man is seen lying at her feet and pleading, while the woman ignores him and refuses to engage. The incident has now been linked to an ongoing family dispute.

The man has been identified as Sanjay, a resident of Mathura, who is married to Lakshmi from the Gonda area of Aligarh. The couple has three children. According to Sanjay, he suspects his wife of having an extramarital affair and claims to possess a video in which she is seen with another man. He alleged that despite informing his in-laws, they supported their daughter and even threatened to kill him.

Sanjay said he later lodged a complaint against Lakshmi at the women’s police station, after which police initiated efforts to mediate between the two sides.

On Monday, both Sanjay and Lakshmi reached the women’s police station as part of the counselling process. During this time, Sanjay reportedly fell at the feet of his mother-in-law, Omvati, within the police station premises, requesting that his wife be sent back with him. His plea was rejected by the mother-in-law. A video of this episode later surfaced and went viral.

Speaking to the media, Sanjay said he had gone to plead for his wife’s return. He claimed that Lakshmi had undergone surgery and that he was falsely accused of beating her. “I have never raised my hand on her. I still send her money for expenses, yet she is having an affair with another man,” he alleged.

He further said that the couple’s eldest son, aged eight, is disabled and has not received proper treatment. Sanjay claimed that his wife took away the money meant for the children and that his in-laws were threatening his life.

Sanjay also appealed to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Prime Minister Narendra Modi for help, seeking action against the man he accused and against his wife, and alleging bias against him in the dispute.

Police said the matter is under mediation and that appropriate action will be taken after examining the allegations of both parties.

articles.title: Woman Begging With Child Detained by Traders on Suspicion in Agra’s Kotwali Area

articles.excerpt: Suspicion prevailed in Agra’s Kotwali police station area after local shopkeepers detained a woman who was begging with a small child in the gold and silver market. The incident took place on December 18, 2025, at around 3.06 pm.

body.html:
Suspicion prevailed in Agra’s Kotwali police station area after local shopkeepers detained a woman who was begging with a small child in the gold and silver market. The incident took place on December 18, 2025, at around 3.06 pm.

According to traders, the woman’s presence with the child raised doubts. When questioned about the child, she reportedly became extremely nervous and failed to give a clear or satisfactory explanation. Her behaviour further strengthened the suspicion of the shopkeepers that the child might not be hers.

Local shopkeeper Shubham Soni immediately informed the Kotwali police about the matter. Police reached the spot and took note of the situation.

Agra Police said the station in-charge has been directed to investigate the case thoroughly and take necessary action based on the findings. Further details are awaited as the probe continues.

articles.title: Bulletproof Scorpio Sparks Panic at MDU: Armed Miscreants Storm Campus, Students Force Them to Flee
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wave of fear and panic swept through Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU) in Rohtak on Wednesday after a group of alleged criminals entered the campus in a bulletproof Scorpio, triggering fears of a possible violent attack.

body.html:
A wave of fear and panic swept through Maharshi Dayanand University (MDU) in Rohtak on Wednesday after a group of alleged criminals entered the campus in a bulletproof Scorpio, triggering fears of a possible violent attack. A video of the incident, reportedly recorded by people present at the spot, has since gone viral on social media.

According to a report by Punjab Kesari, the accused are the same individuals who were earlier arrested for allegedly opening fire on a student inside the university campus. Recently released on bail, they are suspected to have returned with the intention of carrying out another attack. The use of a bulletproof vehicle reportedly indicated prior planning and an attempt to evade retaliation.

However, the situation took an unexpected turn when students gathered in large numbers and showed resistance. Seeing the campus crowded with students, the miscreants panicked. As students attempted to surround the vehicle, the accused fled at high speed.

During their escape, the attackers allegedly drove recklessly across the campus, ramming into several parked vehicles belonging to teachers and students. Multiple cars were damaged, adding to the chaos and outrage on the campus.

The incident has put the MDU administration under sharp scrutiny. As per the report, this is the first time that outsiders allegedly entered the university campus in a bulletproof vehicle, raising serious questions about campus security and administrative preparedness.

Former Deputy Chief Minister Dushyant Chautala reacted strongly to the incident, sharing the viral video on X. He questioned the state’s law and order situation and demanded strict action against goon elements using bulletproof vehicles, tagging Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini in his post.

Police have launched an investigation into the incident and are examining CCTV footage to trace the vehicle’s registration number and confirm the identities of the accused.

articles.title: Rent Dispute Turns Deadly: Landlady Killed, Body Chopped and Hidden in Suitcase by Tenants
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder has come to light in Ghaziabad’s Rajnagar Extension, where a landlady was allegedly killed by her tenant couple over a rent dispute.

body.html:
A shocking murder has come to light in Ghaziabad’s Rajnagar Extension, where a landlady was allegedly killed by her tenant couple over a rent dispute. The incident took place on Wednesday at Aura Chimera Society, where the accused had reportedly not paid rent for the past five to six months.

According to police, the landlady, Deep Shikha Sharma, wife of Umesh Sharma and a resident of the same society, had gone to the tenants’ flat to collect pending rent. When she did not return for several hours, neighbours grew suspicious. CCTV footage later showed her entering the flat in the evening but never coming out.

Acting on suspicion, society residents approached the flat of the tenants. During a search, Deep Shikha Sharma’s body was found dismembered and stuffed inside a suitcase kept under a bed. The accused couple allegedly attempted to flee but were caught and detained by residents before police arrived.

The accused have been identified as Ajay Gupta and Aakriti Gupta, both tenants in the society. Police took them into custody immediately after reaching the spot.

Confirming the incident, Nandgram ACP Upasana Pandey said that information about the murder was received at around 11.15 am on December 17, 2025. “During investigation, it was found that Deep Shikha Sharma had gone to another flat in the society to collect rent. When she did not return, suspicion arose, and her body was recovered from a red suitcase inside the accused’s flat,” she said.

The police have registered a case under relevant sections of the law. Statements of family members have been recorded, and further legal proceedings are underway.

Meanwhile, a video has surfaced on social media allegedly showing the accused couple confessing to the crime. In the video, the man claims he committed the murder due to alleged harassment by the landlady, while his wife interrupts and states that she was also involved in the crime. Police said the video is being examined as part of the investigation.

articles.title: Schoolgirl Seriously Injured After Truck Tyre Burst on Narrow Road in Delhi’s Mehrauli
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A school-going girl was seriously injured after a truck’s tyre burst in Delhi’s Mehrauli area on Wednesday morning. The incident occurred while the girl was on her way to school.

body.html:
A school-going girl was seriously injured after a truck’s tyre burst in Delhi’s Mehrauli area on Wednesday morning. The incident occurred while the girl was on her way to school.

According to local shopkeepers, the truck was slowly moving through a narrow road with the help of a cleaner when the girl approached it. Suddenly, one of the truck’s tyres burst with a loud explosion, striking the girl and leaving her badly injured.

CCTV footage of the incident, which has since gone viral, shows the girl wearing a jacket and walking along the road as the truck attempts to pass through the narrow lane. Moments later, the tyre explodes, after which the girl is seen struggling to walk before being helped away by people nearby.

Shopkeepers said the accident took place around 7.30 am. The injured girl has not yet been identified. Manish Jindal, a local shopkeeper, alleged negligence by drivers of heavy vehicles operating in the market area.

Residents and traders claimed that such risky movement of heavy vehicles is a daily occurrence, as a vegetable market nearby receives large trucks early in the morning, coinciding with school hours. They have demanded strict action by the administration to regulate heavy vehicle movement and prevent similar incidents in the future.

articles.title: Caught on Camera: High-Speed Car Mows Down Bike on Vijayawada Highway, Riders Thrown Into Air
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious road accident was reported on the Vijayawada–Penamaluru National Highway in the Nappalli area on Tuesday morning, with CCTV footage of the incident now coming to light.

body.html:
A serious road accident was reported on the Vijayawada–Penamaluru National Highway in the Nappalli area on Tuesday morning, with CCTV footage of the incident now coming to light.

The accident occurred at around 11.36 am when Syed Asif Basha and Pathan Maqbul, residents of Nappalli village, were travelling on a two-wheeler. As they attempted to take a right turn on the National Highway, a car approaching from the opposite direction rammed into them at high speed.

The car, which was travelling from Vijayawada towards Machilipatnam, hit the two-wheeler with such force that both riders were thrown into the air before crashing onto the road. Asif sustained serious head and leg injuries, while Maqbul also suffered injuries in the impact.

Following the collision, the car came to a halt. Local residents immediately alerted emergency services, and the injured were shifted to Vijayawada Government Hospital. Doctors have confirmed that both victims are currently in stable condition.

The entire incident was captured on a CCTV camera installed at a nearby shop, clearly showing the impact of the crash. The footage highlights the dangers of speeding, especially near crossings on national highways.

Experts have pointed out that many road accidents occur at intersections due to vehicles failing to slow down while entering populated or crossing zones, leading to severe consequences.
